verdict.rationale: GitBook has a first-party docs page titled "Authenticated access" under the publish / site-audience section, so gating a published site behind authentication is its own documented capability. The pack gives only the page title, with no detail on the mechanisms or scope. Missing for 10: evidence of password protection, JWT-based visitor auth, SSO/identity-provider integration, gating only some docs versus all, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I gate some or all docs behind authentication — password, JWT, or SSO — for customers-only content
